stories.title: AsgardBench: A benchmark for visually grounded interactive planning
stories.summary: Imagine a robot tasked with cleaning a kitchen. It needs to observe its environment, decide what to do, and adjust when things don’t go as expected, for example, when the mug it was tasked to wash is already clean, or the sink is full of other items. stories.title: GroundedPlanBench: Spatially grounded long-horizon task planning for robot manipulation
stories.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) use images and text to plan robot actions, but they still struggle to decide what actions to take and where to take them. Most systems split these decisions into two steps: a VLM generates a plan in natural language, and a separate model translates it into executable actions.
